.slider-indicators {
	margin: 0 10px;
}

.slide-dot {
	flex:auto;
    width: 30px;
    height: 8px;
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0 5px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 0;
}

.slide-dot::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, white 50%, transparent 50%);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    background-position: right bottom;
    z-index: -1;
    transition: none;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.slide-dot.active{
	background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
.slide-dot.active::before {
    animation: fillBackground 3s linear forwards;
}

@keyframes fillBackground {
    from {
        background-position: right bottom;
    }
    to {
        background-position: left bottom;
    }
}

	flex:auto;
    width: 30px;
    height: 8px;

    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0 5px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 0;

    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, white 50%, transparent 50%);
    background-size: 200% 100%;

}

    animation: fillBackground 3s linear forwards;

    from {

    }
    to {
        background-position: left bottom;
    }
